画面中，一只穿着蓝白波点睡衣、头戴同款睡帽的橙色小怪物正抱着一个大南瓜，站在木栅栏旁。背景是一座树屋，栅栏内还有其他南瓜和一只蓝色小鸟，场景充满秋日田园气息。

page_text_ocr_zh:
熊王国九月初的一天，秋高气爽，阳光灿烂。熊妈妈收获了本季最后一茬南瓜，正在把它们高高地码到独轮手推车上。这时，远处传来熊爸爸嘹亮的喊声：“顺——山——倒！”熊妈妈知道，他又伐倒了一棵树。
她自言自语地说：“但愿熊爸爸和孩子们小心点儿。”
page_text_en:
One early September day in Bear Country, the weather was crisp and sunny. Mama Bear had just harvested the last batch of pumpkins for the season and was stacking them high on her wheelbarrow. At that moment, from afar came Papa Bear's loud shout: "Down the mountain—go!" Mama Bear knew he had felled another tree.
She said to herself, "I hope Papa Bear and the children are careful."
summary_zh: 本页描绘了熊王国九月初秋高气爽的一天，熊妈妈正在收获南瓜，而熊爸爸在远处伐树，熊妈妈担心他们的安全。

page_text_ocr_zh: “轰隆！”随着一声巨响，树倒在了地上。熊爸爸干活一贯小心谨慎，他用大锯子熟练地锯断了这棵树，和孩子们往后退了几步，看着树倒在小熊哥哥和小熊妹妹用树枝、树叶铺好的一片空地上。
page_text_en: "Boom!" With a loud crash, the tree fell to the ground. Bear Dad, as always careful and cautious, skillfully sawed through the tree with his big saw. He and the children stepped back a few paces, watching the tree fall onto the clear space that Brother Bear and Sister Bear had prepared with branches and leaves.
summary_zh: 熊爸爸用锯子锯倒了一棵树，孩子们退后几步观看，树倒在他们用树枝和树叶铺好的空地上。

page_text_ocr_zh:
树叶落下，灰尘散尽了。小熊妹妹说：“瞧！这上面有圈圈！”
小熊哥哥说：“真的哩！有点儿像把石头扔到池塘里荡起的波纹！”
熊爸爸解释说：“这叫年轮，它能告诉我们树有多大了。”
page_text_en:
The leaves fell, and the dust settled. Little Bear Sister said, “Look! There are rings on it!”
Little Bear Brother said, “Really! It’s kind of like the ripples when you throw a stone into a pond!”
Bear Dad explained, “These are called tree rings. They can tell us how old the tree is.”
summary_zh: 熊爸爸锯倒一棵树后，小熊妹妹和小熊哥哥好奇地观察树桩上的年轮，熊爸爸向他们解释年轮可以显示树的年龄。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小熊妹妹开始数这些圈圈，但数到十二就数不下去了。小熊哥哥接着数：“……二十五，二十六，二十七！哇！这棵树二十七岁了！”
小熊妹妹说：“比我大多了！”
小熊哥哥笑着说：“那当然了！你才五岁。”
小熊妹妹不服气地说：“快六岁了！”小熊哥哥已经八岁了，这使小熊妹妹感到很懊恼。不管她怎么长，都永远赶不上哥哥，这似乎很不公平。
page_text_en:
Little Sister Bear started counting these rings, but couldn't go past twelve. Big Brother Bear continued: "...twenty-five, twenty-six, twenty-seven! Wow! This tree is twenty-seven years old!"
Little Sister Bear said: "That's much older than me!"
Big Brother Bear smiled and said: "Of course! You're only five."
Little Sister Bear protested: "Almost six!" Big Brother Bear is already eight, which made Little Sister Bear feel very annoyed. No matter how much she grows, she can never catch up to her brother. It seems very unfair.
summary_zh: 小熊妹妹和小熊哥哥一起数树桩上的年轮，哥哥数到二十七岁，妹妹因自己快六岁却仍比哥哥小很多而感到懊恼和不公平。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小熊妹妹问：“爸爸，我们也有年轮吗？”
熊爸爸把她抱在腿上，说：“没有。但我们有更好的记法——生日！还有生日聚会！噢，想起来了，你的生日快到了！”
page_text_en:
Little Bear Sister asked, "Daddy, do we have growth rings too?"
Bear Daddy held her on his lap and said, "No. But we have a better way to remember—birthdays! And birthday parties! Oh, I remember now, your birthday is coming up!"
summary_zh: 小熊妹妹询问自己是否有年轮，熊爸爸抱着她解释人类用生日来记录年龄，并提醒她的生日快到了。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“会给我办一个生日聚会吗？”小熊妹妹边喊边兴奋地蹦着。小熊哥哥也激动起来：“咱们办一个非常漂亮的生日聚会好吗？”
熊爸爸说：“当然了，六岁生日可重要了！”
page_text_en:
"Will you throw me a birthday party?" Little Bear Sister shouted excitedly, jumping up and down. Little Bear Brother got excited too: "Shall we throw a really beautiful birthday party?"
Bear Dad said: "Of course! A sixth birthday is very important!"
summary_zh: 小熊妹妹和小熊哥哥兴奋地向熊爸爸请求举办生日聚会，熊爸爸答应并强调六岁生日很重要。

page_text_ocr_zh:
孩子们太兴奋了，他们不停地喊：
“有蛋糕和冰淇淋吗？”
“有装饰物吗？”
“有礼物吗？”
“有游戏吗？”

他们回到家。熊妈妈说：“嗯，
生日聚会？对，六岁生日是需要庆祝一下，咱们可以办一个愉快、安静的小型聚会。”
page_text_en:
The children were so excited, they kept shouting:
"Is there cake and ice cream?"
"Are there decorations?"
"Are there gifts?"
"Are there games?"

They returned home. Bear Mom said: "Well,
birthday party? Yes, a sixth birthday deserves a celebration. We can have a cheerful, quiet little gathering."
summary_zh: 孩子们兴奋地询问生日聚会的细节，熊妈妈回应说六岁生日值得庆祝，并提议举办一个愉快、安静的小型聚会。

page_text_ocr_zh:
但是，小熊妹妹、小熊哥哥和熊爸爸可不想办一个愉快、安静的小型聚会。他们满脑子想的都是办一个热闹、刺激的大型聚会——

邀请许许多多的客人，

有好多好吃的东西，

page_text_en:
But, little bear sister, little bear brother, and bear dad didn't want to have a pleasant, quiet small party. They were all thinking about having a lively, exciting big party—

Inviting many, many guests,

With lots of delicious food,

Games, games, endless games,
summary_zh: 小熊妹妹、小熊哥哥和熊爸爸都希望举办一个热闹、刺激的大型生日聚会，而不是熊妈妈提议的安静小型聚会，他们想象着邀请许多客人、吃很多美食和玩各种游戏。

墙上到处挂满装饰物，

熊爸爸和孩子们满不在乎地说：“忙碌过度的生日？怎么会有那样的生日呢？”
page_text_en:
The walls are covered with decorations,
receiving piles of wonderful gifts,
and there's a delicious-looking birthday cake!
Bear Mom says: "Don't get too excited. Haven't you heard of a 'busy birthday'?"
Bear Dad and the children say carelessly: "A busy birthday? How could there be such a birthday?"
summary_zh: 熊妈妈担心孩子们过于兴奋，提醒他们不要举办‘忙碌过度的生日’，而熊爸爸和孩子们则不以为然，认为不可能有那样的生日。

熊妈妈叹了一口气，她希望

The guest list grew longer and longer.

The birthday cake grew bigger and bigger,

盼望已久的日子终于到了。熊妈妈早早就把生日礼物——一件漂亮的褶边衬衫送给了小熊妹妹。这样，她就可以穿着新衣服参加生日聚会了。
熊爸爸说：“哦，太好了！小马和旋转木马到了。”
熊妈妈有点儿不相信自己的耳朵：“什么东西到了？”
熊爸爸说：“哦，我没给你说过吗？我租了小马和旋转木马！”
page_text_en:
The long-awaited day had finally arrived. Bear Mom had already given the birthday gift—a beautiful ruffled blouse—to Little Bear Sister. This way, she could wear her new clothes to the birthday party.
Bear Dad said, “Oh, great! The little horse and the merry-go-round have arrived.”
Bear Mom couldn’t believe her ears: “What arrived?”
Bear Dad said, “Oh, didn’t I tell you? I rented the little horse and the merry-go-round!”
summary_zh: 生日当天，熊妈妈送给小熊妹妹一件新衬衫，熊爸爸兴奋地宣布租来了小马和旋转木马，熊妈妈对此感到惊讶。

page_text_en: The children are so excited—especially little bear sister! This will be such a grand party!
summary_zh: 孩子们为小熊妹妹的生日聚会感到非常兴奋，画面中展示了装饰华丽的旋转木马车和小马，预示着一场盛大的庆祝活动即将开始。

后，大家一起做起了游戏。

第一个游戏叫“去耶路撒冷”。
游戏规则是：大家围成圈，一圈一
圈地转着，音乐声一停，站在小毯

page_text_en:
At three o'clock, the guests
began to arrive one by one. They wished Little Bear Sister a happy birthday, and the gifts they brought piled up like a mountain. Then, everyone started playing games.

The first game was called 'Go to Jerusalem'.
The rules were: everyone formed a circle, spinning around and around. When the music stopped, the person standing on the small rug was eliminated. The game was so fun — unfortunately, Little Bear Sister was the first one eliminated.
summary_zh: 生日聚会正式开始，客人们陆续到来并送上礼物，随后大家玩起了名为“去耶路撒冷”的游戏，小熊妹妹不幸成为第一个被淘汰的玩家。

page_text_ocr_zh: 接着，他们玩“转瓶子”游戏，这也很有意思——可是小熊妹妹太害羞了，她只敢亲小熊哥哥一个人，引得所有的孩子都哈哈大笑，开她的玩笑。
page_text_en: Next, they played the 'spin the bottle' game, which was also fun — but little bear sister was too shy. She only dared to kiss her brother, which made all the children laugh and tease her.
summary_zh: 生日聚会上，孩子们玩起了“转瓶子”游戏，小熊妹妹因害羞只亲了哥哥，引得大家哄堂大笑。

情况可就不同了，小熊妹妹
一下就钉对了地方。

但她却不能得奖——这
是她的生日聚会，拿奖品是

page_text_en:
When playing the 'Pin the Tail on the Donkey' game,
the situation was different—Little Bear Sister
pinned it right on the first try.

But she couldn't win a prize—this
was her birthday party, and receiving a prize

summary_zh: 在生日聚会上，小熊妹妹玩‘钉驴尾巴’游戏时一次就成功，但因为是自己的生日，大家认为她不能拿奖品，显得很不礼貌。

page_text_ocr_zh: 然后，他们分发小礼物。小熊妹妹得到了一个可伸缩吹管，她吹到了弗雷德的鼻子上，弄得他鼻子直发痒。弗雷德得到的是一个魔法塑料花，他把小熊妹妹的生日衬衣喷得湿淋淋的。
page_text_en: Then, they distributed small gifts. Little Bear Sister got a telescoping blowpipe; she blew it onto Fred's nose, making him sneeze. Fred got a magic plastic flower, and he sprayed Little Bear Sister's birthday shirt until it was soaking wet.

最后，生日蛋糕上来了，该吹灭六

The little horse and the carousel are the most popular with the children.
But little bear sister had eaten too much. She was riding on it, bouncing up and down, spinning round and round, and felt a bit sick.

Finally, the birthday cake arrived. It was time to blow out the six candles. Little bear sister took a deep breath and blew with all her might……
But in the end, not a single candle was blown out.
summary_zh: 小熊妹妹在生日聚会上玩小马和旋转木马时因吃得太饱而感到恶心，之后在吹灭生日蛋糕上的六根蜡烛时，尽管用尽全力，却一根也没吹灭。

page_text_ocr_zh: “你吹几下，长大就会有几个孩子！”朋友们喊着，用古老的迷信跟她开玩笑。她吹了好几下，才终于吹灭了所有蜡烛。大家欢呼起来，齐声唱起了“生日快乐”歌。
page_text_en: "Blow a few times, and you'll have that many children when you grow up!" the friends shouted, teasing her with an old superstition. She blew several times before finally extinguishing all the candles. Everyone cheered and sang "Happy Birthday" together.
summary_zh: 小熊妹妹在生日聚会上努力吹灭蛋糕上的蜡烛，朋友们用迷信玩笑逗她，最终她成功吹灭蜡烛，大家齐声唱起生日歌庆祝。

这时，熊妈妈注意到：两颗豆大的泪珠顺着小熊妹妹的面颊滚下来。歌快唱完了，她放声大哭起来，哭声淹没了大家的歌声。
